_comment: Shared by the Go modelmeta resolver tests and the Python provider resolver tests (0074 review #6). An override is honoured only when it parses to a positive integer after trimming, written in ASCII digits (optional sign) and within int64; anything else (digit-group underscores, non-ASCII digits, overflow, hex, decimals) means 'no override' and resolution falls through to probe/table/family/default.
